brief:
Afaf Fadi al-Haddar's home in Hebron was demolished, the Palestine News Network reported, forcing her and her family into severe humanitarian hardship and instability. Al-Haddar now lacks secure shelter and the basic foundation needed to rebuild her life.

The demolition has stripped the family of their residence and the security it provided, leaving them to navigate displacement without a permanent home.
dek: HEBRON, West Bank / PNN / Palestinian resident Afaf Fadi al-Haddar is facing severe humanitarian and living conditions after her home in Hebron was demolished, leaving her and her family without the security and stability of their own home.
title: Israeli demolition leaves Palestinian woman homeless in Hebron
